subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the legacy no-code orphan diagnostic invalidation in the runtime registry snapshot path, or require that upgrade cleanup live in doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: Root policy normally keeps persistent-state migration debt out of steady-state runtime, but this narrow runtime invalidation unblocks startup for upgraded users with stale SQLite diagnostics; maintainer intent is needed for that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Keep Runtime Invalidation After Proof
options.body: Require visible latest-head legacy-upgrade proof, then accept the narrow runtime branch as startup recovery for stale persisted diagnostics.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Migration
options.body: Ask for a doctor or migration-owned cleanup path instead of runtime legacy detection, reducing steady-state fallback behavior at the cost of a larger repair.

options.title: Accept Current Evidence
options.body: Maintainers can waive the remaining proof ask and merge based on source, tests, CI, and summarized manual output, but that accepts the upgrade risk without visible live artifacts.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Invalidation After Proof
recommendation.body: Require visible latest-head legacy-upgrade proof, then accept the narrow runtime branch as startup recovery for stale persisted diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the explicit-marker direction on the closed predecessor and are the clearest owner for whether the runtime legacy branch matches that intent.
